name: What materials are typically used in the construction of Zen Tiny Homes, and can I choose eco-friendly options?

mainEntity.name: What materials are typically used in the construction of Zen Tiny Homes, and can I choose eco-friendly options?

acceptedAnswer.text: Zen Tiny Homes utilizes high-quality, durable materials engineered for longevity and efficiency. Common materials include sustainable wood framing, energy-efficient insulation, weather-resistant siding, and various interior finishes. Yes, we offer a range of eco-friendly and sustainable material options, such as reclaimed wood, recycled content insulation, and low-VOC paints. We are committed to helping clients achieve their environmental goals through thoughtful material selection.
acceptedAnswer.description: We use durable, high-quality materials like sustainable wood framing and efficient insulation. Eco-friendly options, including reclaimed wood and low-VOC paints, are available for your custom tiny home.
